:::{#exm-marginal-slope-nonindep}

#### A marginal slope under an identity link

Take the parameter values of @exm-marginal-mean-nonindep.
Because the marginal mean is linear in $x$,
the change in $\Ef{Y|X=x}$ from $x = 2$ to $x = 3$ equals its slope.
The code below computes that change,
and the slope from @cor-marginal-slope-nonindep:

```{r}
#| label: exm-marginal-slope-nonindep-calc
#| code-fold: show
ex_marginal_mean <- function(x) {
  (0.1 + 0.1 * 1) + (0.05 + 0.1 * 0.5) * x
}
ex_change <- ex_marginal_mean(3) - ex_marginal_mean(2)
ex_slope <- 0.05 + 0.1 * 0.5
```

The change is `r round(ex_change, 4)`
and the slope formula gives `r ex_slope`,
so the two agree.
The slope exceeds the conditional slope $\b_X = 0.05$,
because $\b_C \gamma_x = 0.05$ is positive.

:::
